compose.body:
name: lettrebox-deploy

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: rwfw
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-rwfw}
      POSTGRES_DB: lettrebox
    volumes:
      - deploy-postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U rwfw -d lettrebox"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 5s

  mailhog:
    image: mailhog/mailhog:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8025:8025"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--spider", "http://localhost:8025"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 5s

  stalwart:
    image: stalwartlabs/stalwart:v0.16.12
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      STALWART_RECOVERY_ADMIN: admin:${STALWART_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-lettrebox-deploy-admin}
    volumes:
      - deploy-stalwart-data:/var/lib/stalwart
      - ${LETTREBOX_SRC:-./projects/lettrebox/source}/config/stalwart/config.json:/etc/stalwart/config.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/healthz/ready >/dev/null || wget --quiet --spider http://localhost:8080/healthz/ready"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s

  app:
    build:
      context: ${LETTREBOX_SRC:-./projects/lettrebox/source}
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.prod
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      RWFW_ENV: production
      RWFW__DATABASE__URL: postgres://rwfw:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-rwfw}@postgres:5432/lettrebox
      STALWART_BASE_URL: http://stalwart:8080
      STALWART_RECOVERY_ADMIN: admin:${STALWART_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-lettrebox-deploy-admin}
      NFSE_CALLBACK_TOKEN: ${NFSE_CALLBACK_TOKEN:-lettrebox-deploy-nfse-callback-token-0001}
      RWFW__ACCOUNTS__MAIL__HOST: ${RWFW__ACCOUNTS__MAIL__HOST:-mailhog}
      RWFW__ACCOUNTS__MAIL__PORT: "${RWFW__ACCOUNTS__MAIL__PORT:-1025}"
      RWFW__ACCOUNTS__MAIL__FROM: "${RWFW__ACCOUNTS__MAIL__FROM:-Lettrebox <no-reply@lettrebox.local>}"
      RWFW__ACCOUNTS__MAIL__STARTTLS: "${RWFW__ACCOUNTS__MAIL__STARTTLS:-false}"
      RWFW__ACCOUNTS__STALWART__BASE_URL: http://stalwart:8080
      RWFW__ACCOUNTS__STALWART__USERNAME: admin
      RWFW__ACCOUNTS__STALWART__PASSWORD: ${STALWART_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-lettrebox-deploy-admin}
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      mailhog:
        condition: service_healthy
      stalwart:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/health"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s

volumes:
  deploy-postgres-data:
  deploy-stalwart-data:

scripts.body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PKG_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$PKG_DIR"

SRC_DIR="${LETTREBOX_SRC:-./projects/lettrebox/source}"

log() { printf '[preflight] %s\n' "$*"; }
fail() { printf '[preflight] FAIL: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "docker not found on PATH"
docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "docker compose plugin not available"

[ -f docker-compose.yml ] || fail "docker-compose.yml missing in package"
[ -d "$SRC_DIR" ] || fail "source dir not found: $SRC_DIR"
[ -f "$SRC_DIR/Dockerfile.prod" ] || fail "$SRC_DIR/Dockerfile.prod missing"
[ -f "$SRC_DIR/config/stalwart/config.json" ] || fail "$SRC_DIR/config/stalwart/config.json missing"
[ -f "$SRC_DIR/Cargo.toml" ] || fail "$SRC_DIR/Cargo.toml missing"

for port in 8080 8025; do
  if (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/${port}") 2>/dev/null; then
    exec 3<&-; exec 3>&-
    fail "host port ${port} already in use"
  fi
done

docker compose -p lettrebox-deploy -f docker-compose.yml config >/dev/null || fail "compose config invalid"

log "OK: docker/compose available, source tree present, ports 8080/8025 free"
scripts.purpose: validate docker toolchain, required files, and free host ports before build

scripts.body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

URL="${HEALTH_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8080/health}"
TIMEOUT="${HEALTH_TIMEOUT:-600}"
INTERVAL="${HEALTH_INTERVAL:-5}"

deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + TIMEOUT ))
attempt=0
while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  if curl -fsS "$URL" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf '[health] OK after %s attempt(s): %s\n' "$attempt" "$URL"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep "$INTERVAL"
done

printf '[health] FAIL: %s did not become healthy in %ss\n' "$URL" "$TIMEOUT" >&2
docker compose -p lettrebox-deploy -f docker-compose.yml ps >&2 || true
docker compose -p lettrebox-deploy -f docker-compose.yml logs --tail=200 app >&2 || true
exit 1
scripts.purpose: poll /health until the app is ready or timeout

projects.name: lettrebox
risks: Rust release build inside container is slow on first run (cold cargo cache); expect several minutes before app becomes healthy.
Stalwart CORS + Bulwark webmail require a one-shot `restart stalwart` after first boot; only enabled if the `webmail` profile is activated (not by default).
Stripe/Focus NFS-e envs (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, FOCUS_NFE_TOKEN) are not set by defaults; billing/NFS-e flows stay inert until real keys are provided.
Compose publishes 8080 and 8025 on the host; VM must not have prior services bound to those ports.

risks.message: First-run Rust release build inside the container downloads and compiles the full dependency graph; expect a multi-minute cold build before the app healthcheck flips to healthy.
Compose binds host ports 8080 (app) and 8025 (MailHog UI); collision with anything already listening on the VM will block the deploy — preflight will fail fast.
Stalwart config is mounted read-only from ${LETTREBOX_SRC}/config/stalwart/config.json; if the copied source omits that file the stalwart service will not start.
Billing (Stripe) and NFS-e (Focus) envs are optional and stay unset by default, so those flows are inert. Not a deploy blocker but must be configured before end-to-end product validation.

summary: lettrebox ships a package-ready compose.deploy.yaml + Dockerfile.prod. The plan reuses the project's own runtime contract (Rust/axum app on :8080 + Postgres 16 + MailHog + Stalwart) and copies the project source under projects/lettrebox/source so compose builds inside the ADE package via LETTREBOX_SRC.
